name: Helen Marsh
summary: High-school science teacher with nine years in the classroom, looking to move into instructional design.

experience.title: Science Teacher
bullets: Taught biology and chemistry to about 120 students a year across five sections.
Rewrote the ninth-grade biology curriculum with two colleagues; the new units are now used by all four biology teachers.
Built weekly assessment quizzes in Google Classroom and used the results to reteach weak topics; pass rate on the unit exam rose from 71% to 84%.
Ran a training session each fall for new teachers on lab safety and Google Classroom.

experience.title: Science Teacher
bullets: Taught seventh and eighth-grade life science.
Made slide decks and printed study guides for every unit.
Served on the school's technology committee and trained staff on the new learning management system.
